module uart_06 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);

  reg [7:0] out_data_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      out_data_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      // Calculate parity bit (even parity)
      // Count number of 1's in in_data
      reg parity_bit;
      integer i;
      reg ones_count;

      ones_count = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
        if (in_data[i]) begin
          ones_count = ones_count + 1;
        end
      end

      // Even parity: 1 if odd number of 1s, 0 if even number of 1s
      parity_bit = ones_count[0] ^ 1'b1;

      // Inject parity bit into MSB of output
      out_data_reg[7] = parity_bit;
      out_data_reg[6:0] = in_data[6:0];
    end
  end

  assign out_data = out_data_reg;

endmodule
